The official guideline says every host app"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" that embeds a WebView must opt in itself:"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Lightweight "shell" browsers (Via, Quark, X, and dozens more) render every page through the system W"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ebView — but **none of them make this call**, so `navigator.credentials()` never reaches the credent"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"ial stack. The capability is already there; the switch is simply never flipped."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"**This module flips it, without touching native app code.** It is a small LSPosed module that hooks "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"`WebView` construction inside target browsers and applies the official integration on their behalf, "},{"id":"p9s3","text":"backed by its own copy of `androidx.webkit`."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"> No patching of the system password manager · no network I/O · no UI injection.

- Creating and verifying passkey"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"s goes through the **native password manager** (ColorOS 密码本, One UI Passcodes, Google Password Manag"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"er…)
- The module keeps gluing itself back on whenever the host re-touches its settings."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## 🧱 Tech stack"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| Layer | What | Why |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| Hook runtime | **Xposed API 93 / LSPosed** | injects into the browser's own process; module off = "},{"id":"p16s2","text":"stock behavior |

| Target"},{"id":"p16s4","text":" floor | **Android 7.0+ (API 24), System WebView 124+** | device must already carry WebAuthn-capable"},{"id":"p16s5","text":" WebView; module enables, never backports |
| Build | **javac → d8 → aapt2 → apksigner** (plain Powe"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"rShell, no Gradle) | ~350 lines total; everything reproducible from one script |
| Depends on nothin"},{"id":"p16s7","text":"g else | no network, no UI, no system writes | reversibility is the design constraint |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"> Why ship our own androidx.webkit? Because the shells never bundle it — the hook must supply the br"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"idge library it is applying."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## 📦 Shell support"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| Browser | Status |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| **Via GP** (`mark.via.gp` 7.3.3) | ✅ tested — passkey **create + verify** work with the native pas"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"sword manager |
